scope: Native startup per-export cancellation after durable reservation but before helper RPC
existing_contract: Runtime::finish rejects Cleanup::NotStarted when attempts is nonempty; do not alter this guard
Unconfirmed follows existing Error/evidenceUnconfirmed logical terminal representation, not a verified Released/root proof
Runtime::job_finished detects any retained Unconfirmed session and marks the job Recovering; preserve this behavior
Foreground None is not a reservation and no unsent helper request may be falsely recorded as attempted

recommended_private_interface.enum: PrepareOutcome { Ready(Arc<Export>), LocalCancelled { unresolved: Option<Error> }, JobStopped } with real failures still Result::Err(JobOutcome)
recommended_private_interface.local_reserved: When local stop is observed after real Attempt ACK Some(correlation), before calling helper, emit actual session Finish with Cleanup::Unconfirmed and an existing fixed cancellation/failure category. Await the same recording response. Do not request helper just to manufacture a terminal proof.
recommended_private_interface.local_unreserved: If no attempt was reserved or sent, actual session Finish may use NotStarted, then LocalCancelled without unresolved metadata.
recommended_private_interface.aggregation: Keep local metadata-only unresolved results in a finite collection (at most configured16) or single bounded aggregate separate from the live-loop JobOutcome guard. At eventual genuine whole-job stop, after all actual close/records are joined, merge it into final JobOutcome.
recommended_private_interface.real_errors: Actual helper error, source invalidation/close failure, known identity error or a real original/Finish recording error remains a job failure. Never classify these as benign local cancellation.
recommended_private_interface.stop_precedence: Global stop remains global even when a local flag is also set. Once helper RPC is accepted, retain it to actual reply; this no-handle branch is no longer applicable.

why_not_merge_immediately: run checks operation/cleanup/recording errors to invoke close_all. Reusing a normal error outcome for intentionally conservative no-handle metadata would grant it unintended authority to close a safe sibling.
minimal_software_assertions: Hold a real Attempt reply while an independent sibling endpoint is acquired; request only local stop, then return Some(correlation)
Assert no new helper connection/Resource occurs after that reply; exact session Finish is Unconfirmed, never NotStarted/Verified
Sibling endpoint remains owned and receives no close; successful late record permits preparation/serving of remaining pool
A later global stop closes the sibling exactly once and returns the conservative final outcome; Runtime still retains Unconfirmed/Recovering
Repeat without reserved attempt for truthful NotStarted and with a late recording error to prove that genuine journal failure still triggers the global-failure path
coordination: Shared with Native author and root; final internal enum spelling may differ, semantics above are the frozen recommendation.
